proposed_widenings.name: Attachment.item_or_object_target
proposed_widenings.justification: Tree Form transforms the staff itself after planting it in the ground. The current activation attachment grammar cannot target the held item/object honestly.
proposed_widenings.evidence: "You can take a Magic action to plant one end of the staff in earth in an unoccupied space and expend 1 charge to transform the staff into a healthy tree."

proposed_widenings.name: EffectAtom.fall_on_end
proposed_widenings.justification: The taxonomy already recognizes this cleanup rider, but the authored surface and tracer do not expose it. Tree Form needs it for the revert clause.
proposed_widenings.evidence: "Any creature in the tree falls when the tree reverts to a staff."

proposed_widenings.name: ItemDestructionPolicy.lose_properties_on_last_charge_roll
proposed_widenings.justification: The last-charge rider is a permanent magical shutdown, not destruction. Current destruction variants can only destroy the item or do nothing.
proposed_widenings.evidence: "If you expend the last charge, roll 1d20. On a 1, the staff loses its properties and becomes a nonmagical Quarterstaff."

notes: Authored subset includes the held bonuses, druid-only attunement, charge-cast spell table, and dawn recharge. Tree Form and the non-destructive last-charge shutdown were omitted and recorded in the proposal.
